# SQL AVG() Function

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## SQL AVG() Function

The AVG() function is used to calculate the average of numeric values in a column. For example,

```sql
1-- Return the average of all employees' salaries
2
3SELECT AVG(salary) 
4FROM Employees;
```
